context: Documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on a leader's legacy.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; civic vocabulary (大統領/設置/審議/会見/財産) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この大統領は、何を残したんですか?
lines.en: What did this president leave behind?
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 多くの機関を、設置しました。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 長い審議の末に、決めたんですか?
lines.en: Did he decide after long deliberation?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、慎重な審議を重ねました。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 会見では、どう語ったんですか?
lines.en: How did he speak at his conferences?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 会見で、国民の財産を守ると述べました。
lines.en: At conferences, he vowed to protect citizens' assets.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国の財産を、大切にしたんですね。
lines.en: So he valued the nation's assets.
lines.style: understanding young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その大統領の決断が、今も生きています。
lines.en: That president's decisions live on today.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity closing throughout
